correctness.rationale: For 0<alpha<1 a_j is the length-j binary-prefix integer; subtracting S_n gives a_{n+1}-S_n=w_{n+1}. Disjoint intervals strictly between S_n and a_{n+1} are unreachable, giving infinite gaps after the second one-bit. Single-one scales yield powers of two. At alpha>=1 the initial deficit d_0>=1 and d_(n+1)-d_n in {0,1}; all infinitely many levels have gaps. Uniform binary cylinders yield Bin(n+1,1/2), summing (w-1)_+ gives exact expectation, and digit frequency plus logarithmic index gives (delta/2)(log_2 X)^2+o(log^2 X) for canonical holes only. Independently checked exact rational floor identities and absent intervals over dozens of parameters and ten prefix lengths; finite checks are not the proof.
